original_query: What is the biggest reason why users sometimes choose not to use enterprise BI applications?

confirmed.answer_text: The biggest reason users avoid enterprise BI applications is 'Do not have all the data you need' at 45%.; The study was conducted in March 2014 by Forrester Consulting on behalf of SAP.; The sample size was 302 business and IT decision-makers who influence BI decisions.
confirmed.summary: The page displays a bar chart from a 2014 Forrester Consulting study commissioned by SAP, showing the top reasons business and IT decision-makers avoid using enterprise BI applications. The reasons include lack of data, complexity, incorrect data models, slow results, and restrictive data models, with percentages indicating their prevalence.
key_facts: The biggest reason users avoid enterprise BI applications is 'Do not have all the data you need' at 45%.
The study was conducted in March 2014 by Forrester Consulting on behalf of SAP.
